description: Find all CVEs affecting a specific product and version using CPE (Common Platform Enumeration). Requires either an exact CPE name (cpeName) or a partial match string (virtualMatchString) with optional version range bounds. With cpeName, NVD scopes results to configurations where the product is directly vulnerable, not merely referenced as a dependency. Use nvd_search_cpes first to resolve the correct CPE string for a product. Narrow the audit server-side with kevOnly, an exact severity band, or publication, last-modified, or KEV-addition date windows; pubDays, lastModDays, and kevDays expand to date pairs ending at call time, values over 120 days are clamped and reported, and a shorthand re-expands on every call, so page with the dates echoed in filtersApplied. Returns full CVE records including current SSVC assessments, each score's supplier, and the affected products the CNA and any ADP state themselves.

allLanguages.description: When true, keeps every localized description NVD supplies on each record. Default keeps English only.

cpeName.description: Full CPEv2.3 name (e.g., "cpe:2.3:a:apache:http_server:2.4.51:*:*:*:*:*:*:*"). NVD adds isVulnerable automatically. Mutually exclusive with virtualMatchString.

includeAffected.description: When false, omits affectedProducts from each record and its rendered text.

includeConfigurations.description: When false, omits configurationNodes from each record and its rendered text.

includeReferences.description: When false, omits references from each record and its rendered text.

kevDays.description: CVEs CISA added to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog in the last N days: expanded to kevStartDate/kevEndDate spanning exactly N × 24 hours up to call time (max 120; values over 120 are clamped). Returns only catalog members. Mutually exclusive with kevStartDate/kevEndDate. Each call re-expands it, so page with the dates echoed in filtersApplied.

kevEndDate.description: End of the KEV-addition window, in the same form as kevStartDate. Both kevStartDate and kevEndDate required together.

kevOnly.description: When true, limits the audit to CVEs in the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, whenever CISA added them. A KEV window (kevDays or kevStartDate/kevEndDate) already returns only catalog members.

kevStartDate.description: Start of the window in which CISA added the CVE to the KEV catalog, as YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm[:ss[.fraction]] with an optional Z or ±hh:mm offset, e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z; a value without an offset is read as UTC. Both kevStartDate and kevEndDate required together, at most 120 days apart. Returns only catalog members. Mutually exclusive with kevDays.

lastModDays.description: CVEs last modified in the last N days: expanded to lastModStartDate/lastModEndDate spanning exactly N × 24 hours up to call time (max 120; values over 120 are clamped). Mutually exclusive with lastModStartDate/lastModEndDate. Each call re-expands it, so page with the dates echoed in filtersApplied.

lastModEndDate.description: Last-modified range end, in the same form as lastModStartDate. Both lastModStartDate and lastModEndDate required together.

lastModStartDate.description: Last-modified range start, as YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm[:ss[.fraction]] with an optional Z or ±hh:mm offset, e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z; a value without an offset is read as UTC. Both lastModStartDate and lastModEndDate required together, at most 120 days apart. Mutually exclusive with lastModDays.

limit.description: Maximum number of CVEs to return (default 20; values above 2000 are clamped unless NVD_CLAMP_LIMITS is false).

offset.description: Zero-based page offset for pagination. Page through totalCount with a modest limit rather than raising limit — this tool returns full CVE records, so a large limit is a large response.

pubDays.description: CVEs published in the last N days: expanded to pubStartDate/pubEndDate spanning exactly N × 24 hours up to call time (max 120; values over 120 are clamped). Mutually exclusive with pubStartDate/pubEndDate. Each call re-expands it, so page with the dates echoed in filtersApplied.

pubEndDate.description: Publication range end, in the same form as pubStartDate. Both pubStartDate and pubEndDate required together.

pubStartDate.description: Publication range start, as YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm[:ss[.fraction]] with an optional Z or ±hh:mm offset, e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z; a value without an offset is read as UTC. Both pubStartDate and pubEndDate required together, at most 120 days apart. Mutually exclusive with pubDays.

severity.description: Server-side filter to CVEs in exactly this CVSS severity band at severityVersion — NVD matches the one band, not a floor, so totalCount and paging count that band alone. Covering several bands (e.g. HIGH and CRITICAL) takes one call per band. Combines with severityMin, which then filters the fetched page across every CVSS version.

severityMin.description: Keep CVEs whose highest severity band across all CVSS versions meets this threshold, which can exceed the row headline severity. Applied after NVD returns the page, so only CVEs within limit are evaluated and totalCount is unchanged; for a server-side band that totalCount and paging count, use severity.

severityVersion.description: CVSS version to use for the severity filter. Default: v3 (maps to cvssV3Severity).

versionEndType.description: Whether the upper version bound is inclusive or exclusive.

versionStartType.description: Whether the lower version bound is inclusive or exclusive.

virtualMatchString.description: Partial CPE match pattern (e.g., "cpe:2.3:a:apache:http_server:*"). Use with versionStart/versionEnd for version range audits. Mutually exclusive with cpeName.

name: nvd_audit_cpe

auditTarget.description: The CPE name or virtual match string used for this audit.

cves.description: Full CVE records for CVEs affecting the specified product.

items.description: CVE record for one vulnerability affecting the product; configurations, affected products, and references can be omitted by caller selectors.

affectedProducts.description: Affected products as the CNA and any ADP state them, one entry per product — their own statement, not NVD analysis, and often the only product and version evidence on a record NVD has not analyzed. Read versions with versionChanges and defaultStatus. Empty when no contributor sent any.

collectionURL.description: Package collection that gives packageName its meaning (e.g. a registry URL).

cpes.description: CPE names the contributor attached to this product.

defaultStatus.description: Status of every version the versions list does not cover: affected, unaffected, or unknown. Absent when the contributor stated none, which the CVE schema reads as unknown.

platforms.description: Platforms the statement is limited to. Absent means every relevant platform.

source.description: Who made this statement — the CNA or an ADP — as the contributor name NVD publishes for it (e.g. "CISA-ADP"). Contributors NVD identifies by email address keep that address (e.g. "security@apache.org"); an identifier absent from NVD's contributor dictionary passes through as its raw value.

vendor.description: Vendor, project, or maintainer of the product.

versionChanges.description: Status changes inside version ranges, moved out of their range so each stays addressable; versionIndex names the range. Within one range, sort by version under its versionType before applying them.

items.description: One status change inside a version range.

at.description: Version at which the status changes.

status.description: Status from this version on, until the next change or the range end.

versionIndex.description: Zero-based index of the versions entry whose range this change is inside.

versions.description: Versions and ranges with their status, in the order the contributor listed them. A range can change status partway through; versionChanges carries those points.

lessThan.description: Exclusive upper bound of the range.

lessThanOrEqual.description: Inclusive upper bound of the range.

status.description: Status of this version or range: affected, unaffected, or unknown.

version.description: A single version, or the inclusive lower bound of a range.

versionType.description: Version scheme a range is compared under (e.g. "semver", "git", "custom"). Absent on a single version.

cisaKev.description: CISA KEV fields. Present only when CVE is in the KEV catalog.

exploitAddDate.description: Date added to CISA KEV catalog.

configurationNodes.description: Affected product configuration nodes. NVD nests these under configuration groups; the groups are represented by groupIndex so each node's own criteria stay together.

items.description: One affected product configuration node, tagged with the group it came from.

cpeMatch.description: This node's CPE match criteria, in the order NVD lists them.

vulnerable.description: Whether this CPE is the vulnerable component or only the context it runs in.

groupIndex.description: Zero-based index of the NVD configuration group this node belongs to. Nodes sharing a groupIndex were siblings in one group, combined by groupOperator.

groupOperator.description: Logical operator (AND/OR) combining this node with its sibling nodes in the same group. An "AND" means every node in the group must match for the CVE to apply — e.g. a firmware node and the hardware it runs on. Absent when the group has nothing to combine.

nodeOperator.description: Logical operator (AND/OR) combining this node's own criteria below. Absent when the node has nothing to combine.

cveTags.description: Tags contributors attached to the CVE. Absent when none did.

source.description: Who attached the tags, as the contributor name NVD publishes for it; email-form identifiers keep their address.

cvssScores.description: All available CVSS scores across versions.

severity.description: Severity label: CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, or LOW.

source.description: Who supplied the score, as the contributor name NVD publishes for it (e.g. "CISA-ADP"). Contributors NVD identifies by email address keep that address (e.g. "nvd@nist.gov"); an identifier absent from NVD's contributor dictionary passes through as its raw value. Absent when NVD names no source.

sourceType.description: NVD's label for this score, "Primary" or "Secondary". It does not say who scored it — a CNA's score can be Primary and an ADP's Secondary; source names the scorer.

source.description: Who contributed the reference, as the contributor name NVD publishes for it (e.g. "CVE", "CISA-ADP"). Contributors NVD identifies by email address keep that address (e.g. "security@apache.org"); an identifier absent from NVD's contributor dictionary passes through as its raw value.

severity.description: Top severity. Absent if no CVSS scores present.

fromVersion.description: Which CVSS version this top score came from.

label.description: Highest severity label across all CVSS versions.

sourceIdentifier.description: The contributor NVD lists as the record's source — the CNA that submitted it — as the contributor name NVD publishes for it (e.g. "CPANSec"). Contributors NVD identifies by email address keep that address (e.g. "cve@mitre.org"); an identifier absent from NVD's contributor dictionary passes through as its raw value.

ssvc.description: Current SSVC assessments in upstream order.

decisionPoints.description: Ordered option objects; repeated keys remain separate.

additionalProperties.description: One string or ordered list of strings.

source.description: Contributor name or original source identifier.

Who classified the weakness, as the contributor name NVD publishes for it (e.g. "CVE", "CISA-ADP"). Contributors NVD identifies by email address keep that address (e.g. "nvd@nist.gov"); an identifier absent from NVD's contributor dictionary passes through as its raw value.

datesClamped.description: Entries for any pubDays, lastModDays, or kevDays value that exceeded 120 and was clamped. Absent when no clamping occurred.

items.description: A single clamping event for one convenience date parameter.

param.description: The shorthand that was clamped (pubDays, lastModDays, or kevDays).

effectiveLimit.description: Page size or ID count used after clamping.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `nvd_invalid_response`: NVD returned an invalid response. `nvd_request_blocked`: NVD blocked the request. `missing_cpe_input`: Neither cpeName nor virtualMatchString was provided. `conflicting_cpe_inputs`: Both cpeName and virtualMatchString were provided simultaneously. `version_range_without_match_string`: versionStart or versionEnd was provided without virtualMatchString. `invalid_cpe_format`: cpeName or virtualMatchString does not start with "cpe:2.3:", or NVD rejected it as a malformed CPE parameter — cpeName rejects anything short of a complete CPEv2.3 name, virtualMatchString only genuinely malformed characters. `nvd_request_rejected`: NVD rejected a request parameter other than the CPE — a date it cannot parse, or a range it measures past 120 days — or rejected the request without naming a parameter. `mutually_exclusive_params`: A date shorthand was sent with its explicit range: pubDays with pubStartDate/pubEndDate, lastModDays with lastModStartDate/lastModEndDate, or kevDays with kevStartDate/kevEndDate. `missing_date_pair`: Only one end of a date range was provided (pubStartDate/pubEndDate, lastModStartDate/lastModEndDate, or kevStartDate/kevEndDate) — NVD requires both. `date_range_inverted`: The end date of a date range is before its start date. `date_range_exceeds_max`: An explicit date range (pubStartDate/pubEndDate, lastModStartDate/lastModEndDate, or kevStartDate/kevEndDate) spans more than 120 days. `invalid_date_format`: A date field (pubStartDate, pubEndDate, lastModStartDate, lastModEndDate, kevStartDate, or kevEndDate) is not a date and time in the form NVD accepts. `invalid_severity_for_version`: severity="CRITICAL" was specified with severityVersion="v2" — CVSS v2 has no CRITICAL tier. `rate_limited`: NVD explicitly reported that the rate limit was exceeded. `nvd_unavailable`: NVD answered with HTTP 5xx, or the request or its response failed on the network, after the client retried. `nvd_timeout`: An NVD request outlived its timeout, or the call ran out of its 55-second deadline. `nvd_invalid_api_key`: NVD refused the server's configured NVD_API_KEY. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

filteredCount.description: CVEs below severityMin on every CVSS band, or with no scores, on the page NVD returned. Present whenever severityMin is set; 0 means none were dropped. Bands across all versions are evaluated independently of the row headline; CVEs beyond limit were not evaluated.

filtersApplied.description: The server-side filters this audit applied beyond its target — the ones totalCount counts within, and that can account for an empty or unexpectedly narrow result. Absent when none was set. severityMin is reported on its own field because it filters the fetched page, not the NVD query.

kevEndDate.description: Effective KEV-addition window end sent to NVD.

kevOnly.description: Present as true when results were limited to the CISA KEV catalog.

kevStartDate.description: Effective KEV-addition window start sent to NVD.

lastModEndDate.description: Effective last-modified range end sent to NVD.

lastModStartDate.description: Effective last-modified range start sent to NVD.

pubEndDate.description: Effective publication range end sent to NVD.

pubStartDate.description: Effective publication range start sent to NVD.

severity.description: The exact CVSS severity band that was applied — results are limited to this band alone, so higher bands are not included.

severityVersion.description: The CVSS version the severity filter matched on. Present only alongside severity.

notice.description: Guidance on the shape of this page. When no CVEs came back it distinguishes a target NVD holds no CVEs for from a target with none matching the server-side filters, from a severityMin filter that dropped everything on the page, from an offset past the result set, from an empty page NVD returned inside a range it says has matches. A page severityMin emptied names the offset of the next page while CVEs remain past it, or says the target is exhausted at that threshold once none do. On a partial page it names the offset that reaches the next one. On the first page of a window a shorthand set, any next-page offset it names comes with the filtersApplied dates to send in its place; past offset 0 it flags a shorthand window re-expanded for this call and points to the first page's dates instead. Also reports blank date filters it ignored.

offset.description: Page offset used in this query.

requestedLimit.description: Requested page size, or distinct ID count, before clamping.

severityMin.description: The client-side minimum severity filter applied. Absent when none was set.

title: Audit CPE for Vulnerabilities
